execution: live production site through signed-in Chrome controls; original-message exports graded locally
notes: Single-trial smoke suite, not a reliability estimate. The original 18 natural user prompts are unchanged; two new prompts cover an ordinary table request and an explicit request for Markdown source. Every case used a fresh agent with the default purpose and the model profile observed in the report. This execution used normal Chrome controls, not the separate Playwright CLI runner.

Conversational cases now reject Markdown tables as a general rule. Both product cases also reject a redundant DataTable or Comparison after the Products card. The sole source-format exception requires an explicitly requested fenced Markdown snippet without a rich card.

The historical control uses the same new grader on the previous 18 original-message archives, without modifying those archives or their older reports: 17 pass and shopping fails solely for its repeated Markdown table. This checks the concrete formatting regression; it is not a controlled estimate of broader model quality or performance.

The ordinary table request produced a DataTable through show_ui, with exactly the three supplied records and numeric hours. Manual UI checks confirmed descending numeric order 16, 12.5, 8; ascending order 8, 12.5, 16; and filtering Design to Ada and Cara. The explicit README-source case returned only a fenced Markdown table with the requested names and hours, without a presentation tool.

Shopping encountered Google verification and used normal Currys Ireland pages without bypassing the challenge. Three retailer open requests received individual Allow once approvals; no persistent permissions changed. Successful observations supported Sony ULT Wear EUR 129 with up to 30 hours ANC on / 50 off, and Bose QuietComfort EUR 239 with up to 24 hours advertised. The Bose source does not specify its battery-test mode; the result explicitly caveated that uncertainty, so the figures are not a controlled battery benchmark.

Shopping produced one Products card followed by a short recommendation and caveats, without a Markdown recap or second rich table. Manual UI checks exercised the two-product shortlist and comparison view. No purchase, basket change, confirmed delivery charge or address-specific stock claim occurred.

The forecast-horizon case used an isolated current-date calculation, reviewed and approved once, then explained the forecasting limitation without calling lookup_weather or fabricating a precise year-ahead forecast. Its broad seasonal estimates were not independently fact-checked by this suite.

All four weather cases, three calculation cases, route, map, comparisons and negative controls passed. All 20 exports contained their exact request once. No failed tool, failed model turn, renderer fallback or stale-client reload was observed.

All 20 new eval agents were recoverably archived after export. Private original-message archives, screenshots, UI evidence and full grader outputs stay in ignored evals/rich-answers/results/tables-2026-10-18.

The suite checks bounded facts and presentation contracts, not every claim, recommendation or visual detail. Provider data can change between runs. Operator approvals and manual UI checks are recorded separately from automated checks.
